items.name: Fortnite Mobile Series LAN
items.description: The road to glory leads to Copenhagen. On October 24–25, 2026, the world's top 16 mobile players will gather at BLAST Studios in Denmark for the Fortnite Mobile Series LAN Championship. After months of fierce competition, the best players from across the globe will face off on LAN in Reload Solos, battling for the ultimate title. Every elimination matters. Every placement counts. Only one player will rise above the rest and be crowned the 2026 Fortnite Mobile Series Champion.

items.name: FNCS Solos Reload Qualifiers
items.description: Drop into the FNCS Solos Reload! The competition kicks off with Round 1, featuring two sessions—Day 1 and Day 2. Eligible players must rank within the top 200,000 on the Global Power Rankings Leaderboard. Players ranked in the top 1,000 Global PR may skip Round 1 and automatically qualify for Round 2; however, choosing to compete in Round 1 forfeits that automatic qualification. After both Round 1 sessions conclude, scores from Day 1 and Day 2 will be combined. The top players on the cumulative leaderboard will advance to Round 2: Top 4,000 EU; Top 2,000 NAC; and Top 1,000 OCE, ASIA, ME, BR, and NAW. Round 2 features the players who advanced from Round 1 alongside eligible Top 1,000 Global PR players who skipped Round 1. At the end of Round 2, the top 500 players in each region will advance to Round 3. Round 3 is the final round of the Qualifier, with the top 80 players in each region advancing directly to the Heats. Players who competed in the Qualifier but did not advance to the Heats will still have another opportunity to qualify through the Last Chance Qualifier (LCQ). Good luck and have fun!

items.name: FNCS Solos Reload Heats
items.description: Heat up your path to the FNCS Solos Reload Final! The Heats bring together 80 players per region who advanced from Round 3 of the Qualifier. Players will be split across two Heats, with 40 players competing in each Heat. Each Heat features eight matches. Each match offers a direct path to the Final: the player who earns a Victory Royale automatically advances to the FNCS Solos Reload Final. A player who has already secured a spot in the Final through a Victory Royale cannot earn another Final spot by winning another match. After each Heat concludes, the top seven highest-scoring players who did not earn a Victory Royale will also advance to the Final, bringing the total to 15 players from each Heat. The next 10 players from each Heat who did not qualify for the Final will earn a bye directly to the Last Chance Qualifier Final. Good luck and have fun!

items.name: FNCS Solos Reload Last Chance Qualifier
items.description: Keep your FNCS Solos Reload journey alive in the Last Chance Qualifier! LCQ Round 1 is open to players who participated in the FNCS Solos Reload Qualifier and have not already advanced to the LCQ Final or the FNCS Solos Reload Final. After LCQ Round 1 concludes, the top 20 players in each region will advance to the LCQ Final, where they will join 20 players who earned a bye through the Heats, creating a 40-player lobby. The LCQ Final features five matches. Every match provides a direct path to the Final: the player who earns the Victory Royale will immediately qualify for the FNCS Solos Reload Final. A player who has already secured a Final spot through a Victory Royale cannot earn a second Victory Royale qualification spot. After the LCQ Final concludes, the next five highest-scoring players who have not earned a Victory Royale will also advance to the FNCS Solos Reload Final, for a total of 10 qualifying players from the LCQ Final. This is your last chance to secure a spot—good luck and have fun!

items.name: FNCS Solos Reload Last Chance Qualifier
items.description: Keep your FNCS Solos Reload journey alive in the Last Chance Qualifier! LCQ Round 1 is open to players who participated in the FNCS Solos Reload Qualifier and have not already advanced to the LCQ Final or the FNCS Solos Reload Final. After LCQ Round 1 concludes, the top 20 players in each region will advance to the LCQ Final, where they will join 20 players who earned a bye through the Heats, creating a 40-player lobby. The LCQ Final features five matches. Every match provides a direct path to the Final: the player who earns the Victory Royale will immediately qualify for the FNCS Solos Reload Final. A player who has already secured a Final spot through a Victory Royale cannot earn a second Victory Royale qualification spot. After the LCQ Final concludes, the next five highest-scoring players who have not earned a Victory Royale will also advance to the FNCS Solos Reload Final, for a total of 10 qualifying players from the LCQ Final. This is your last chance to secure a spot—good luck and have fun!

Cash prizes will be awarded to top players at the conclusion of Round 2's test event.

items.name: Arenas Fight Night
items.description: Arenas Fight Night is an invite-only 1v1 event where players will have up to 10 reboots per match and battle it out in Arenas Boxfights for cash prizes. Contenders are selected from the Power Rankings. In Round 1, two contenders face off for a shot at the title. The winner advances to Round 2 to take on the Champion. Whoever wins Round 2 is crowned Champion and returns to defend their crown at the region’s next Fight Night. Good luck and have fun!
